scoring_justification: Full recompute is infeasible without re-running the cross-sectional FEM and 1D beam solver; the verifier instead evaluates the deflections against paper-reported values with tolerance and checks a relative trend (linearity ratio).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference deflections from paper Table 2 (ABA-0th) for the composite beam at 50 V, 100 V, 150 V
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, column ABA-0th: 50V → 5.8 µm, 100V → 11.7 µm, 150V → 17.5 µm
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values copied directly from the published paper (doi:10.1088/0964-1726/20/2/025023, Table 2). They are the exact numbers reported by the authors and serve as the hidden gold for the reproduction target.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own experimental-validated numbers; using any other values would defeat the reproduction purpose.

outputs.description: Tip deflections of the piezoelectric fiber composite beam at actuation voltages of 50 V, 100 V, and 150 V.

output_contract.notes: Only the zeroth-order asymptotic solution (ABA-0th) is required. Higher-order corrections, the pure piezoelectric bimorph validation, 3D FEM comparisons, and rule-of-mixture analysis are excluded from this reproduction task.
